text:
morgan: Quick heads-up — nightly perf CI (03:12 PT) flagged p95 +18% on small-batch for model-redwood-v1 (quantized). Run: bench-4209876543. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/bench/bench-4209876543 :eyes:

ci-bot: ALERT: p95 increase detected vs baseline (commit a1b2c3 -> a1b2d0). Metric: small-batch p95 188ms -> 222ms (+18%). Logs & flamegraphs: https://ci.redwood/bench/bench-4209876543/artifacts

sasha: ugh. any quick suspects? recent kernel scheduler or batcher changes in the last 24h?

morgan: no obvious PR pinned yet. Nightly included the `batch-scheduler-fix` and a runtime memopt refactor. flagging both. can someone grab a perf trace on the failing commit?

ian: I can take bisect if someone drops repro steps. Can we rerun single-model focused job with `BATCH=4` and `SEQ=1024`?

alex: repro command I use locally:
```
./bench --model=model-redwood-v1 --batch=4 --seq=1024 --runs=30 --capture=nsys --out=perf-4209
```
Uploads to s3:
```
aws s3 cp perf-4209/ s3://redwood-ci/perf/4209876543/ --recursive
```

sasha: also collect `perf record -g` or `nsys` for GPU stacks. NVTX traces help.

ian: taking ownership. I'll run a focused job on the failing commit and the immediate previous commit and upload traces to s3. ETA ~40m. ping me if you need logs sooner.

morgan: awesome — if you find tails pointing to the batcher, tag @eng-runtime and add the flamegraph link. Also consider turning off the memopt refactor patch in a canary to see if it regresses back.

ci-bot: scheduled rerun: bench-4209876543-repro by ian queued on runner gpu-x3. artifacts will post when done.

alex: quick note — if it's scheduler-related, try running with `--cpu-affinity=0,2,4` to see if isolation helps.

morgan: thanks all. if bisect narrows to PR, let's coordinate rollback/patch in the morning. i'll stand up an async thread for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
